Key Takeaways
The meeting focused on addressing a significant business slowdown and strategizing marketing efforts to boost sales.
Main issues included a 40% sales drop, ineffective past marketing campaigns, and language barriers in video content.
Follow-up actions involved increasing ad spending, creating new marketing content, and exploring international expansion opportunities.
Strategies were proposed to improve marketing efforts, enhance SEO, and develop multilingual content to boost engagement and sales.

IPO Influence
Lack of data sharing due to IPO preparation impacts business operations, marketing strategies.
Business slowdown possibly linked to focus on upcoming IPO, affecting data transparency and marketing efforts.
Await IPO-related developments before making significant changes to business strategies.
Marketing and Promotion Strategies
Team exploring various marketing strategies to boost footfalls and sales, including utilizing social media, influencer videos, and lookalike audiences.
Need for effective marketing strategies to counteract slowdown.
Focus on promoting product categories and use Google promotions to increase visibility.
Create new content featuring product-making videos for Instagram, other platforms to engage customers.
Previous campaigns, especially during festive seasons like Diwali, did not yield expected results.
Google Promotions
Emphasis on increasing Google promotion efforts to improve business visibility and attract more customers.
Plan implement aggressive Google promotion strategies enhance visibility.
Need for increased marketing efforts to boost business visibility and footfalls.
Business Slowdown
Business experiencing significant slowdown past four months, impacting sales, footfalls. Notably, 40% drop from March levels.
Sales declined 40% from March baseline, leading to concern.
Attempts to boost footfalls through past campaigns, particularly during festive seasons like Diwali, have been ineffective.
Increase ad spending to 7,000-8,000 INR/day from current 4,000 INR to improve business performance. Evaluate results next Monday's call.
Language and Multilingual Content
Develop scripts adaptable to multiple languages to cater diverse audiences.
Language barriers in video content limiting reach and engagement.
Multilingual content creation planned to engage broader audience and enter new markets.
Focus on creating content in Kannada, Telugu, and Hindi, exploring expansion in regions like Bombay and Pune.
Content and Video Creation
Ineffective past marketing campaigns, lack of engaging content.
Team prioritizing creation of engaging video content featuring product-making processes to boost online engagement.
Develop multilingual content broaden audience reach.
Collaborate with influencers for content creation and edit videos to use across various platforms.
Export Planning
Limited export activities, untapped potential in Tamil-speaking regions.
Plan execute export strategies targeting Tamil-speaking regions for increased market presence.
Developing export strategies for Tamil-speaking regions, focusing on Malaysia, Singapore, Sri Lanka, to boost market presence.
International Expansion
Exploring international markets, focusing on Tamil-speaking regions like Malaysia and Singapore, to expand market presence.
Start promoting products in Malaysia, Singapore, Sri Lanka, using targeted content and campaigns.
Limited international presence, identified opportunities in Tamil-speaking regions.
SEO and Technical Improvements
Team addressing technical SEO issues to improve online visibility, engagement, including URL restructuring.
Link SEO content to relevant products for direct business impact.
Conduct SEO audits, fix issues, optimize content, and URL structures for better search engine visibility.
Shopify limitations affecting URL structure, necessitating rework.
Pain Point
No specific actions have been taken to boost Instagram footfalls, except for influencer videos.
There was a significant decrease in work rate by almost 40 percent from the baseline in retail, with no significant gains during the festive month, particularly during the last week.
Currently, there are no orders coming in from there.
Limited variety of products made from palm jaggery available in the restaurant and dry snacks section.
Palm jaggery is not a core millet and there are very few products made from it on the website.
